objective: Provide an independently hammerable address-timed replay source for the actual ep34 decoder positive planes under exactly three M1536-authorized non-product configurations. Do not launch production or publish transactions, cycles, traffic, speedup, energy, PPA, Table A, or paper results.

population.D0_D1_numeric: exact bit-times-layer-float32-constant; never coerce to one and never fold weights

forbidden_configuration.name: PRODUCT_CAPTURE_TYPED_K8
forbidden_configuration.reason: M1526 has no authorized ep34 decoder INT8 rule, payload identity, kernel/ATLIF miter, Acc24 proof, or paired official AEE authority.

ports.psum: 6-bank 1RW, 48 B/bank row, read latency 2, write latency 1, II 1
ports.external: 1-bank 1RW, 192 B/cycle, read latency 32, write latency 3, II 1
ports.compute: one 96-lane Acc24 context, 288 B service row, latency 1, II 1

common_resource.commit: dense all output sites in identical address order, 384 B per 96-output block

replay_semantics.dense: issue every structural source contributor through typed bank-unique groups
replay_semantics.bit_equal_service_k1x8: issue only exact positive-plane contributors as eight independent K1 descriptor/weight services; equal service but not equal area
replay_semantics.bit_typed_k8: issue the same exact positive-plane contributors through one shared typed bank-unique K8 group
replay_semantics.same_contributor_requirement: BIT_EQUAL_SERVICE_K1X8 and BIT_TYPED_K8 must conserve identical contributor and compute-group populations
replay_semantics.timing: fixed-latency deterministic bank/port calendar with explicit addresses, dependency tokens, issue cycles, return cycles, and identical dense commit hashes

future_one_shot_cost_envelope.expected_serial_cpu_wall_time: 24-72 hours; must be calibrated by a separately sealed 1-call pilot before the only production attempt
future_one_shot_cost_envelope.expected_peak_memory: streaming target below 8 GiB; fail if the future runner materializes the complete transaction population
